title: Media & advertising
note: B2 leaf to the Travel 3 template, 2026-09-05. New strand anchored to News (B1) and Tech 1-3 - the recap card says so explicitly. Owns press/outlet/streaming/viral for the level (F7 first-theme ownership; News 2 at slot 12 defers). Family card: endorse/sponsor/subscribe/stream/present -> endorsement/sponsorship/subscriber/streaming/presenter, all drilled. Pool-checked; audience/broadcast/advertise/headline/campaign already taught and excluded.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: This unit has no Media 1 — it grows out of two families you know: News (headline, broadcast, journalist, coverage, campaign) and Tech (stream, subscription, notification). New here: who watches, who pays, and how they get you to buy.
cards.note_cz: Tahle jednotka nemá Media 1 — vyrůstá ze dvou rodin, které znáš: News (headline, broadcast, journalist, coverage, campaign) a Tech (stream, subscription, notification). Nové je: kdo se dívá, kdo to platí a jak tě přimějí nakoupit.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Verbs you know become this unit's people and things.
**-er**, **-ment**, **-ship** and **-ing** do the building — five of the 36 words.
